summary: Landed the closed-loop loft SECTION representation in truck123d/src/bd_bridge.rs. spline_loop_spans now orients a recorded section boundary into one connected closed ring (exact endpoint matching, reversing an edge's defining samples when its recorded END, not its start, meets the running ring end) and treats a single spline edge as a closed ring closed on its start vertex (the landed spline-profile extrude convention). The pinned canonical MONO-2 N-station convention (chord-length stations, C2 across them, per-patch certificate brackets) is reused unchanged. This flips f1/halo green: all 14 halo solids certify exact brackets (lo == hi) and the STL emits. f1/nose, f1/sidepod_left/right and f1/cockpit remain TYPED refusals for reasons outside this packet's carrier representation (recorded below). corpus/ttc/door.py's Face/Edge/Wire `.wrapped` now refuse TYPED instead of returning None, so the corpus's OCC bounds probes surface as typed door refusals rather than untyped OCP TypeErrors (judgement 4: keep refusals typed).

functions: profile_edge_endpoints (new): the recorded start/end traversal of a line/spline edge
reverse_profile_edge (new): the exact reverse curve of one recorded edge
orient_profile_ring (new): greedily orients the recorded edges into one connected closed ring; an already-connected loop keeps its recorded order bit-for-bit
spline_loop_spans (extended): single circle/ellipse unchanged; single spline -> closed_spline_spans; multi-edge line/spline -> oriented ring
closed_spline_spans (new): closes a single spline section on its start vertex (the landed spline-profile extrude convention) and reconstructs the clamped-cubic spans
implementation.convention_reuse: No new facts path: the oriented spans feed the landed spline_loft_volume_rows / certified_spline_loft_volume per-patch certificate, station_params, v_segments and spline_loft_mesh unchanged.

per_row.note: The section band (spline + line + spline, both splines recorded from the same start vertex) is oriented into a connected ring; the spine stripe's single periodic spline is closed on its start vertex. bbox is the carrier-derived control-net ENCLOSURE; it over-reports the OCC reference z-max by 0.474 mm (864.330 vs 863.856), which is the documented N>2 certified-enclosure property, not an OCC match gate.

The nose's own lofts now certify (all sections are single periodic splines handled by closed_spline_spans). The row's only remaining blocker is the 20 `head + boss` fasteners in lib/nose.py `_flange_fasteners`: a canonical CYLINDER + CYLINDER union. The landed canonical boolean product (`boolean_product_volume_certified` -> `node_box_patches` -> `placed_box_patches`) carries axis-aligned boxes only, so the pair refuses. Routing a canonical cylinder pair through the MONO-6/8/9 swept solver would need rational (non-unit-weight) cylinder patches, which the contact-cover solver's `cell_flux_exact` does not consume; this is not the swept-loft operand extraction this packet covers. Typed refusal recorded, never approximated.

The sidepod skin/duct lofts now certify. The row refuses at lib/sidepods.py `_lip_bezel` (`ring_out - ring_in`, a Swept x Swept pair): the MONO-8 extraction adapter `extract_local_patches` -> `loft_cap_row` carries only straight QUADRILATERAL section end caps, while the sidepod section loops are curved spline loops. A second, corpus-side blocker stands behind it: `_bounded` in lib/sidepods.py calls `surfaces.bbox` (an OCC `BRepBndLib` probe) on the kernel row, which cannot be served and now refuses TYPED. Both are typed; neither is approximated.
Mirror of sidepod_left (same factory); identical typed refusal at `_lip_bezel`.

per_row.note: The R3 DNF (`RuntimeError: cockpit: loft failed`) is resolved: the seat shell loft now certifies, so `_solid` accepts its base. The build then reaches the corpus's own OCC bounds sanity check `_prism_estimate` -> `surfaces.bbox` on the recorded section Faces.
